title: ‘Drown All the Refugees’ by Tabish Khair: Ancient knowledge of the land is the only way to freedom

title: Rare fossil of T. rex cousin goes on display in New York before heading to auction

title: Ancient ‘Sphinx crocodile’ reveals surprising local connection
description: A newly identified crocodilian lived in Egypt around 45 million years ago - and its closest living relatives include Malaysia’s false gharial.

title: Common Words and Names Inspired by Ancient Deities
description: The influence of the Roman Empire is everywhere. The many gods of the Latin world influence everything because the Latin language spawned other languages, and a lot of our scientific terms deliberately use Latin. Latin and Greek mythology gave us the names of the planets and the months. But deities from polytheistic religions came into our language from all over.
